name: luckylillia-plugin-webui-demo
description: Adds a page, a Dashboard card, WebQQ chat and message extensions, a plugin card button and a color field to the WebUI

description.zh: WebUI 扩展示例：侧边栏页面、Dashboard 卡片、WebQQ 聊天窗口按钮和消息渲染（markdown 原文、折叠长消息）、插件卡片按钮，以及一个按 role 注册的取色控件
description.en: WebUI extension example: a sidebar page, a Dashboard card, a WebQQ chat button and message rendering (markdown source, long messages folded), a plugin card button and a color field registered by role
